tier.reason: Apps: a FastAPI server and a local model via Ollama

headline: No blockers found. 5 things will need a fix and 2 need you.

aiUsage.reason: Every fix found follows a known pattern; the AI would step in only if a check failed.

findings.title: Starts worker processes without a __main__ guard
findings.why: Windows and macOS start worker processes by re-running the script, so top-level code runs again in every worker and can loop or crash.
findings.fixPattern: Move the code that starts the pool into main() and call it under if __name__ == "__main__":.

findings.title: Opens text files without saying they're UTF-8
findings.why: On Windows, Python before 3.15 reads and writes text in the old Windows code page unless told otherwise, so accents and emoji come out wrong or crash.

findings.title: Run script has no Windows version
findings.why: run.sh is a shell script, and Windows can't run it without Git Bash or WSL.
findings.fixPattern: Add a PowerShell version next to it (run.ps1), or replace it with a Python or Node script that runs on both.

findings.title: Glues paths together with '/'
findings.why: Gluing paths with '/' mostly works on Windows, but breaks with drive letters, network paths and Windows tools that expect backslashes.
findings.fixPattern: Join paths with pathlib (Path(base) / name) or os.path.join; in Node, path.join.

findings.title: Run command uses python3
findings.why: On Windows the command is usually `python` or `py`; `python3` may open the Microsoft Store instead.
findings.fixPattern: Use `python` (or `py -3`) on Windows, or run through `uv run` / `python -m` so the same command works on both.

findings.title: Secrets aren't sent automatically
findings.why: .env holds these settings: OPENAI_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, CHAT_MODEL. SeamDrop never sends secrets without asking.
findings.fixPattern: Move them yourself, or set them up again on Windows (a password manager helps).

findings.title: Needs Ollama running
findings.why: Ollama has to be running where the project can reach it (it uses the dependency ollama).
findings.fixPattern: Install Ollama on Windows, or run it with Docker.

findings.title: Package builds for Windows weren't checked
findings.why: Some Python packages ship no ready-made build for every OS and have to be compiled. Checking means asking PyPI, and this scan stayed offline.
findings.fixPattern: Scan again with the online package check, or watch for compile errors when installing on Windows.

findings.title: .venv won't be sent
findings.why: .venv holds packages installed for this computer (1.6 GB); it's rebuilt on the other side from the project's dependencies.
findings.fixPattern: Nothing to do: the receiving side rebuilds it (uv sync, or pip install -r requirements.txt).

findings.title: Scripts marked executable
findings.why: Windows doesn't keep the Unix "executable" flag. Nothing breaks on Windows, but if these come back to a Mac they may need chmod +x.
findings.fixPattern: Nothing to do now. Coming back: chmod +x run.sh.
